task.instruction: Search an Xbox Wireless controller with green color and rated above 4 stars.

final_answer:
I searched Amazon for a green Xbox wireless controller with the "4 Stars & Up" filter on. The search found 814 results. These are the best matches.

Official Xbox / Microsoft green controllers:
- Xbox Wireless Controller – Grey/Green (Microsoft): 4.6 stars from 15.7K ratings.
- XBOX Wireless Gaming Controller | Electric Volt: 4.6 stars from 19.6K ratings. It is marked "Overall Pick" and has 900+ bought in the past month.
- Xbox Wireless Controller – Velocity Green (Renewed): 4.4 stars from 177 ratings, MYR 227.10, with free delivery to Malaysia.
- Xbox Series X/S/One Wireless Controller – Electric Volt (Renewed): 4.3 stars from 537 ratings, MYR 225.07.
- Microsoft Xbox Wireless Dual Controller Bundle (Velocity Green): 4.2 stars from 21 ratings.

Third-party green controllers:
- Retro Fighters Hunter Wireless Controller, Green: 4.5 stars, MYR 241.88.
- 8Bitdo Ultimate 2C Wireless Controller (Green): 4.4 stars from 8K ratings. It works with Windows PC and Android, not Xbox consoles.
- Razer Wireless Controller & Charging Stand, Limited Green Edition: 4.2 stars.
- Custom soft-touch controllers (Neon Green, Olive Green, Green Camo, Yellow & Green): 4.2–4.6 stars, about MYR 446.

The highest-rated official green options are the Electric Volt and the Grey/Green controller, both at 4.6 stars. The lowest-priced official one is the Renewed Velocity Green controller at MYR 227.10.

I haven't opened any product pages or added anything to your cart.

judge.rationale: Amazon results page shows “xbox wireless controller green” with 4 Stars & Up filter and green Xbox controllers rated 4.4/4.6 stars.
